name: sgs/modal
title: SGS Modal
description: Trigger button that opens a modal overlay with any content inside. Fully accessible with focus trap and keyboard navigation.

trigger.label: Trigger button
trigger._note: triggerColour/triggerBackground resolve via the default {prefix}{suffix} convention (Colour/Background suffixes). Rendered as a scoped rule `.uid .sgs-modal__trigger{...}` (render.php:37-43,73-75), not inline. triggerBackgroundGradient's attrMap entry added 2026-09-03 (the default convention has no Gradient-suffix awareness, so the gradient sibling floated as an unclaimed orphan). triggerColourGradient's attrMap entry added D956 (778879732 rollout, Phase 3) -- text-colour gradient sibling to triggerColour, background-clip:text mechanism; the D942 comment in render.php already anticipated and freed this slot by cancelling the class default's background-color when no explicit triggerBackground is set.

dialog.label: Dialog
dialog._note: This block declares containerMirror:false (does NOT wrap SGS_Container_Wrapper) and disables native color support entirely — every declaration is block-private, scoped via render.php:37-79. maxWidth resolves via the bare-prefix default convention (case-insensitive `MaxWidth` -> `maxWidth`, render.php:21,95); modalBackground is mapped explicitly since the bare prefix + Background/Bg suffixes do not match its 'modal' name segment.

backdrop.label: Backdrop / overlay
backdrop._note: overlayColour/overlayOpacity drive `--sgs-modal-backdrop-colour`/`--sgs-modal-backdrop-opacity` custom-property VALUES on the wrapper (render.php:54-66), allowed inline per contract §A since they are variable values, not real property declarations. Mapped explicitly — overlayColour doesn't carry a Colour/BackgroundColour suffix match under the default convention. overlayColourGradient (2026-09-06, colour-conformance closeout) is its gradient sibling, same custom-property-gradient shape as tabBgColour/panelBgColour (sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls()) — non-empty wins over the flat overlayColour.

close.label: Close button
close._note: The dialog close button (.sgs-modal__close). Added 2026-09-03 alongside the hover-colour migration off a hardcoded style.css :hover rule -- render.php calls sgs_button_element_style_css() with prefix 'close', which reads exactly this attrMap shape by $prefix.'Suffix' concatenation. closeColourTextGradient/closeColourTextHoverGradient added 2026-09-04 (helpers-button-style.php D942/D956 gate) -- keyed css:color-gradient, distinct from the fill's css:background-image, since this element's real .sgs-modal__close background lives on a separate ::after pseudo-element (style.css:180), not this selector, so a text gradient here only ever competes with the OPERATOR-set closeColourBackground(Gradient), never the CSS-authored default. sgs_button_element_style_css() only paints the gradient when that operator background is unset (per-state).

overlayColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the dialog backdrop scrim via a background-image custom-property sibling (helpers-tokens.php sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls). Non-empty wins over overlayColour.
